other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the Charmakar community.
Applicant must provide an Income Certificate and a Caste Certificate issued by an authorized government officer.
Applicant must have knowledge of the business for which the loan is sought.
For the 50% Subsidy Scheme and Margin Money, the applicant's annual income must be below the poverty line.
For the NSFDC Scheme, the applicant's annual income should not exceed ₹98,000 in rural areas or ₹1,20,000 in urban areas.
benefits_summary: Financial support of ₹25,000–₹50,000 with a 5% annual interest rate and an additional ₹10,000 subsidy.
